description: Stateless NACL for the public subnet 10.20.4.0/24, where the load balancer lives. Rules are evaluated from the lowest number upward; the first match decides; no match means deny.

inbound.description: known abusive range: block everything, even web ports (lowest number so it wins over 100-130)
SSH only from the management subnet
replies from the app subnet (port 8000) to the load balancer's ephemeral ports
nothing else (same as the implicit default deny)

outbound.description: load balancer to the inference service on the app subnet
replies to clients anywhere, on their ephemeral ports
nothing else (same as the implicit default deny)
